story_info.title: Bella Bear Helps Grandma
story_info.subtitle: A Cozy Afternoon of Kindness
story_info.moral: Helping others, especially family, makes everyone happy.

slides.title: A Visit to Grandma
slides.text: Bella Bear bounced to Grandma Bear's home. It was a sunny afternoon. Grandma Bear lived in a cozy den in Sunny Forest. Bella had soft honey-colored fur and a gentle smile. She loved visiting Grandma. 'Hello, Grandma!' Bella called. Grandma smiled, but she looked a little tired.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella Bear arrives at Grandma's house, seeing Grandma looking a bit tired.

slides.title: A Basket of Yarn
slides.text: 'Oh, hello, my sweet Bella,' Grandma Bear said. Grandma had kind, wise eyes and wore a cozy shawl. 'My back is a bit stiff today. I wanted to sort my yarn balls. They are all mixed up!' She pointed to a big basket. It was full of colorful yarn.
slides.speaker_notes: Grandma Bear explains her problem to Bella, showing the messy yarn basket.

slides.title: Bella Offers to Help
slides.text: Bella looked at the basket. Red, blue, yellow, and green yarn. 'I can help you, Grandma!' Bella said with a kind smile. 'Kind hearts make happy days!' She sat down. Bella picked up a red yarn ball. Then she found another red one.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella offers to help Grandma and starts sorting the yarn.

slides.title: Working Together
slides.text: Bella carefully put all the red yarn together. Then she found all the blue yarn. Grandma Bear watched. Her heart felt warm. Bella worked patiently. She made neat piles of yarn. Soon, the big basket was tidy and colorful.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella patiently sorts the yarn into neat piles while Grandma watches happily.

slides.title: Happy Hearts
slides.text: 'Thank you, Bella,' Grandma said. She hugged Bella gently. 'You are such a kind bear.' Bella felt happy inside. Helping Grandma made her feel good. They shared a warm cup of berry tea. It was a wonderful afternoon.
slides.speaker_notes: Grandma thanks Bella, and they enjoy a warm moment together, feeling happy.
